text: For the all-pass ring resonator, the resonant transmission drops to exactly zero at ___ coupling, the condition where the self-coupling coefficient r equals the round-trip field survival a.
explanation: Critical coupling (a = r) makes the on-resonance transmission vanish because the circulating and coupled fields interfere fully destructively. Both the under-coupled case (a > r) and the over-coupled case (a < r) give nonzero resonant transmission.
